profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.hint: Each profile is an independent mod set stored under _smms/profiles inside the game folder. Pick a profile at launch time to choose which mods get loaded.
profiles.adoptMessage: Pick an existing Stardew Valley folder (for example a modpack you backed up yourself). SMMS references it directly — no files are copied or moved, and launching runs the game and mods inside that folder.

profiles.deleteMessage: This deletes "{0}" along with all mod files inside it. This cannot be undone.
profiles.renameMessage: Enter a new name. The folder name stays the same, so existing mods and the manifest are untouched.

profiles.isolation.fullHint: Copies the entire game folder (about 1–2 GB, takes tens of seconds). The copy carries its own SMAPI, so it can run a different game version than the main install.

discover.hint: The Chinese Stardew community refers to mods by their Nexus ID — type the number to look it up, or browse popular and recent releases. Uses the public API; no account needed.

vanity.hint: Manage Content-replacing packs (XNB overrides). SMMS keeps a backup of the originals, so you can switch back anytime. Close the game before switching.

vanity.subtitle: Appearance · {0} replacement packs · {1} extra content packs
vanity.replaceTag: XNB overrides · one active at a time
vanity.replaceDesc: Overwrites images and sounds in the game's Content folder — a complete restyle, but packs exclude each other. Originals are backed up and can be restored anytime.
vanity.switchTip: On = apply (only one pack at a time), off = deactivate
vanity.rules1: Only one replacement pack can be active at a time; switching backs up the originals first, then overwrites.
vanity.rules2: Only XNB files under the game's Content folder are touched — saves and the Mods folder are left alone.
vanity.rules3: Steam verification or a game update may restore the assets; SMMS will prompt you to re-apply on next launch.
vanity.dropHint: Dropping a zip auto-detects the type: a manifest.json goes to the right as an extra content pack; XNB-only Content archives go left as an asset replacement.
vanity.emptyPackagesHint: Use "Import XNB pack" at the top right, or drop an XNB-only archive into the window.
vanity.extraDesc: Loaded as content packs — they only add or replace specific assets without overwriting originals, so several can be enabled at once and they share the Mods page toggles.
vanity.emptyContentPacksHint: Drop a content pack archive (with manifest.json) into the window, or use "Import content pack" at the top right.
discover.installGuide: SMMS does not download mods: open the Nexus page, then drag the downloaded archive into the window to install.
vanity.singleActiveHint: Only one pack is active at a time — applying a new one deactivates the current pack.
updates.manualGuide: SMMS doesn't download mod files for you: open the mod page, download the new zip, and drop it into the window to overwrite-install — a snapshot is taken first.
updates.smapi.guide: Run the installer after downloading — SMMS picks up the new version; press Recheck here afterwards.
updates.manual.title: Snapshot first, then install
updates.manual.note: Before a manual overwrite-install, SMMS snapshots the active profile; if it breaks, restore from the Rollback points below — the failure reason is kept too.
